Commentary.Commentary: Wonderful scenes as the sun sets here at the Queens Sports Club. Sarfraz Ahmed takes the trophy and along with his teammates, poses for photographs. It has been a dream tour for them. First, they won the tri-series by beating Australia in the final. After that, they were unstoppable in the ODI format against the hosts. Zimbabwe need to do a lot of homework if they are to stand up against top sides. Thanks for your company. You can switch tabs as the first ODI between Windies and Bangladesh is going on in Guyana. Till then, cheers!

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed says it has been a brilliant team performance. Appreciates the way Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam and Imam-ul-Haq played. Mentions he is happy with how everybody fared. Admits they need a month's rest and then they are looking forward to the matches they are going to play ahead.

Fakhar Zaman, Man of the Series, says he has enjoyed his time here in Zimbabwe. Mentions he always looked to take his time, punish the bad deliveries and respect the good balls and it has worked well for him. Ends by saying he will continue to work hard and he hopes he continues scoring runs for his side.
Babar Azam is the Man of the Match for his blazing 106. His knock towards the end gave Pakistan a strong finish.

Zimbabwe skipper, Hamilton Masakadza says he is happy with their effort with the bat. Adds further that he is disappointed though as no batsman pushed on after getting a start. Admits they tried to score something around 250-270 but that wasn't to be. Mentions they now realize how big a gap there is between the top teams and them. Ends by saying they will hope to improve and are looking forward to the future games.

Murray was unlucky not to get to his maiden ODI fifty. Peter Moor also played his hand, he remained unbeaten till the end along with Elton Chigumbura. For Pakistan, Nawaz and Hasan took two apiece. No other bowler had a wicket to his name but the important thing is that they were quite frugal throughout. Stay tuned for the presentation in a bit.

It all started with Hamilton Masakadza and Tinashe Kamunhukamwe adding a 66-run stand for the first wicket before the latter departed to Nawaz. Hasan then bowled a beauty to get rid of the skipper. Two wickets in quick succession and at that time, it seemed like the visitors would once again run through the batting line-up but that did not happen. Prince Masvaure and Ryan Murray took their time and added a 78-run stand.

So, Pakistan have inflicted a whitewash. Well, that was very much expected at the start of the day. Another thumping performance from them. Zimbabwe though will be a lot more happier with their batting performance in this game. Although they never looked like chasing this massive target, their batsmen showed character and will to play out the 50 overs.

Full toss down leg, swept away towards fine leg for a run. That's it, a complete domination from the visitors throughout. Big smiles among their players as the customary handshakes take place. PAKISTAN WIN BY 131 RUNS, TAKING THE SERIES 5-0!
In line of the stumps, skids through after pitching. Moor adjusts in his crease to block it.
Going away with the arm, punched off the back foot to covers.
Short ball on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Well outside off, left alone.
SIX! Got the treatment it deserved! A half-tracker, Moor lines it up and hammer-pulls it over cow corner to send it sailing over the fence.
Leans ahead and pats it to covers for a single.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
Turning away from Moor as he taps it to the off side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy delivery, eased to mid off.
Floated up generously around off, eased through mid off for a run. Sarfraz's first over in international cricket yields 6 runs.
Elton goes back and punches it nicely to rotate strike.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Sliding across as he punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
On a shorter length again, stays a touch low. Punched down the ground towards long on for a couple.
Starts off with a half-tracker, pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Well, well, well, a surprise! The captain, Sarfraz Ahmed comes on for a bowl. He has his cap on as well. Can he get a wicket? Fakhar Zaman will keep wickets in place.
Tossed up ball, worked past mid on for a run.
Rocks back and cuts this one to sweeper cover for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Very full delivery, pushed back to the bowler.
Another misfield! Sarfraz is not amused at all. Pakistan have been shoddy in the field today. Driven towards covers where the fielder makes a mess of it to concede a couple.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Low full toss outside off, stroked away towards deep cover. Zaman runs to his right, dives and saves a couple for his side. He is a good athlete.
SIX! Shot! Slower shortish ball outside off, Moor picks the change of pace and pulls it with aplomb over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Moor is hit on the pads again but this one is missing the leg stump.

Another appeal falls on deaf ears! Fuller in length, tailing in nicely. Chigumbura tries to flick it away but is struck on the pads. The ball deflects towards short third man as the batsmen set off for a leg bye. Ali shouts for it but the umpire remains unmoved. Was going down leg.
On a good length outside off, Elton stonewalls it.
Angling in on a length, tucked with a closed bat face to mid-wicket.
On a shorter length on middle, kept out from the comfort of his crease.
Comes right forward to the tossed up ball and sees it off.
Stump-to-stump line, answered with a straight bat.
Moor comes ahead again in order to defend this one but the ball whizzes past the outside edge of his bat.
Full and outside off, driven crisply to deep cover for a run.
Quicker through the air, spinning away. Chigumbura tries to defend it but he gets beaten.
Good length on off, kept out.
FOUR! Second of the over! 200 up for Zimbabwe. Short and outside off, Moor guides it through backward point and the ball races away.
A bumper, EC pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
A yorker on middle, Elton jams it out.
FOUR! Short ball and it has been put away! Chigumbura rocks back and cuts it through point. The ball races away. This is now Zimbabwe's highest total in this series.
On the body of the batsman. The batsman tries to flick but misses to get hit on the body.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack.
Tosses it up on off, Moor prods forward and blocks it.
The leg spinner on off, Moor lunges forward and defends it.
The googly, Moor picks it. He whips it through square leg and the batsmen run two.
Floats it up on off, Chigumbura eases it down to long off for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Moor slaps it down to long off for a run.
Flatter outside off, this one stays a touch low. The batsman tries to punch it through the off side but gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
Shadab Khan is back on.
Full length ball, driven crisply but straight to the mid off fielder.
A bit fuller in length, Moor decides to hang back and defends it nicely.
On the tight off stump corridor, Peter defends it with his bat and pad close together.
Good length ball outside off, glided down to third man to change strike.
Pitched up ball outside off, tapped to the cover region.
Back of a length ball, Elton hangs back and defends it stoutly.
Keeps this one out from the comfort of his crease. Nawaz finishes with good figure of 10-0-47-2.
Floated ball, knocked down to long off for a run.

Howzat? The answer to that one is Not Out. Slower through the air, Chigumbura steps down the track to counter it but is hit on the pads. Nawaz goes up vociferously but the umpire stays put. He was too far outside his crease. The bowler has a wry smile on his face.
A bit of extra bounce on this one as Elton mistimes his drive towards covers.
Coming in with the arm, eased down to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring now.
SIX! That has gone all the way! That one came right off the screws. In the slot for Chigumbura. He smokes it over long off for a biggie.
Chigumbura winds up for a big shot but he doesn't have space to work with. Ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
An off cutter around the pads, read nicely by Peter as he plays it through the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
Goes for another yorker but this time ends up dishing out a half-volley. Moor fails to capitalize on it as he drives it straight to extra cover.
Bowls a pinpoint yorker but Moor is equal to the task. With a steady head, he jams it out near him.
Starts his new spell with a good length ball on off, punched crisply off the back foot to the cover region.
Junaid Khan comes back for a bowl.
Tossed up nicely, Elton comes forward and blocks it with authority.
Shorter in length, crunched through covers for a run.
FOUR! A gift down the leg side, a low full toss. Moor kneels and gets some bat on the sweep shot. That is good enough to take it to the fine leg fence.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Peter clears his front leg and strokes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on a fullish length outside off, driven crisply to long off to rotate strike.
Sliding in towards Moor as he tucks it to the man at 45 for a single.
A little trigger on the front foot from Chigumbura as he blocks the full length ball right under his eyes.
Leans ahead to the full length ball and jams it down the track.
Low full toss on middle, played gently towards mid off.
Well bowled! The off cutter going across Elton as he fails to defend it and gets beaten.
Fullish delivery around off, kept out watchfully.

Techincally a dropped chance but would have been a stunner had he caught it! Short delivery and room on offer, Moor tries to cash on it as he goes for a slap, hitting it towards the backward point region. Shadab leaps to his right like a goalkeeper, gets a hand to it but the ball doesn't stick. Has landed a bit awkwardly but seems to be fine.
Outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Fuller in length, eased down to long on for a run.
Elton Chugumbura ambles out to bat.

OUT! Cleans him up! Nawaz bowls this one quicker again on middle and leg, Murray goes for the slog sweep but the execution is not there on this occasion. Misses it completely to get his stumps shattered. Ryan misses out on his maiden ODI fifty as Pakistan march towards inflicting a whitewash on Zimbabwe.
Almost went through the defenses! Quicker and on a flatter trajectory, just kept out in the nick of time.

Dropped and SIX! In line of the stumps, Murray kneels and slog sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Zaman in the deep runs in a bit but the judgement is not good. Realizes that he has to leap. Gets a hand to it but only to parry it over the ropes.
Coming in with the arm, punched off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Two Wides! Down the leg side, Sarfraz fails to collect the ball cleanly, deflecting it towards the man at 45. The batsmen run one as well.
Change of ends for Mohammad Nawaz.
Fuller length ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Yorker around off, Ryan jams it out towards covers.
Similar length ball on the same channel, worked towards mid on.
Good length ball in line of the stumps, tucked with a closed bat face towards short mid-wicket.
On a length on off, played with an open bat face to off side.
Full length ball, coming in with the natural around the wicket, tucked around the corner for a single.
FOUR! Some swagger in that shot! On a length, angling in, Murray comes forward confidently and whips it through wide mid on for a rocketing boundary.
On a length outside off, tapped towards third man for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Murray once again goes for the pull but mistimes it again. The ball falls well short of the mid on fielder.

In the air... but safe! Short ball, rising on Murray. He is hurried by the pace as he goes for the pull but top edges it over mid-wicket. No one placed there and Ryan gets a couple. This is his highest ODI score, 36. Good going from him.
Full length ball, around off, Murray comes forward and blocks it nicely.
A shortish ball in line of the stumps, Moor arches back, drops his wrists and evades it well.
Similar length ball, leaving Moor. He plays it nicely with an angled bat to the point fielder.
On a length around off, answered with a straight bat.
Amir opts to pitch this one up, no reverse for him. Moor comes forward and taps it to covers.
A touch straighter on the same length, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Good length ball, angling across Moor. He hangs back and blocks it right under his eyes.
Mohammad Amir returns.
Full length ball, tailing in nicely. Ryan is equal to the task as he comes forward to defend it with his bat and pad close together. A wicket and a run from the over.
Short of a length outside off, Peter guides it to third man for a single and he gets off the mark.
Shaping in prodigiously from a fuller length outside off, inducing an inside edge onto the pads.
Yorker around off, kept out by Moor.
Peter Moor is the next man in.

OUT! Hasan Ali strikes for the second time in this game! Masvaure who was playing a good knock has to walk back. Length ball around off, Masvaure tries to loft it down the ground but is not quite to the pitch of it. The ball takes the bottom half of his bat and lobs towards mid on. Asif Ali stationed there loses it for a while but keeps calm. Dives in front to take it inches above the ground. The 78-run association ends.
On a length around off, Prince hangs back and stonewalls it.
A touch shorter this time, a solid back foot defense from Ryan.
Wide! Fired down the leg side, Murray misses the flick.
Slower through the air, Prince leans ahead and taps it through mid off for a single.
Sits on the back foot and turns it around the corner to rotate strike.
Sliding on from around the wicket, punched past point for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Good length ball outside off, Masvaure punches it off the back foot through covers to rotate strike.
Waits for this one and taps it through point for a single.

A huge appeal for an LBW is turned down! Full ball from around the wicket, coming in with the natural angle. Masvaure falls over a bit as he misses the flick to get hit on the pads. Ali is confident but the umpire shakes his head. Maybe it was going down leg.
On a length around off, kept out towards covers.
Wide! Ali goes for the bouncer but it is too short. Prince sways away from the line of the delivery. Wide called for height.
Pitched up ball outside off, Ryan leans ahead to guide it through covers and picks up a single.
On a length around off, Murray puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Short of a length outside off, placed past point for a single.
Hasan Ali is back on.
Comes ahead to the loopy ball to dead-bat it.
Rocks back to the shortish ball and knocks it down to long off for a run.
Shortish this time, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.

Dropped! The second drop catch in a short span of time. Malik gives this one more loop, bowling it outside off. Masvaure uses his feet but fails to reach the pitch of the ball. Ends up skewing the loft off the outer half of the bat over wide mid off. Imam runs in from long off but makes an absolute meal of it. Misjudges it as the ball goes past his hands and deflects off his legs to his right. Sarfraz shakes his head in disappointment. A couple taken.
Full ball, driven hard towards the bowler who ends up deflecting it towards mid off. A run taken.
Hangs back to the quicker one and punches it out.
Gets right forward to that one and taps it through mid off for a single.
Murray fails to read the googly as he attempts to drive it through the line but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
FOUR! Easy pickings! The straighter one but it is down the leg side, all Murray has to do is get a tickle on it and he does so. Gets it past the keeper to the fine leg ropes.
Not too short to pull this one and Murray opts to jab it towards mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy delivery, turned towards mid on.
Waits for the ball to come to him and works it around the corner for a run.
Fuller in length, knocked down to long on for a run.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated outside off, chipped nicely over wide mid off for a single.

SIX! Clean as a whistle! Loopy delivery around off, the shot selection is good from Murray as he crouches and nails the slog sweep over cow corner for a massive maximum. That brings up the 50-run stand between the two, also the second of the innings. They need to up the ante though.
Slower through the air, eased towards mid off.

Dropped! You got to take these catches at this level. Sarfraz is not happy about it. Full delivery just outside off, Murray brings out the whip with a lot of bottom hand on it. It flies towards Malik at short mid-wicket who tries to take it but the ball pops out and falls on the ground.
Tossed up ball on a fuller length, pushed down the track.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Brilliant batting from Masvaure! He has been quite assured against the spinning ball. Makes room, reads the googly to perfection and goes inside out over covers to find the ropes.
Flighted ball outside off, an easy single as Prince taps it through mid off for a run and will retain strike.
Floated delivery outside off, Murray drives it down to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, Ryan steps forward to counter it.

A bit of breakdown in comminucation between the two batsmen but no harm done in the end! Masvaure works it towards square leg. His partner calls him through for a run but he is late to react. Takes off eventually and makes his crease safely in the end.
Masvaure goes for an extravagent drive through the line but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up ball, driven crisply to long off to rotate strike.
Shoaib Malik comes in for a bowl.
Slower through the air, spinning away. Murray gets to the pitch of the ball and taps it through covers. A single taken.
On a flatter trajectory, Murray hangs back and blocks it.
Spinning down the leg side, tickled away towards short fine leg to rotate strike.
In line of the stumps, kept out watchfully.
Loopy delivery around off, Ryan comes forward and drives it to long off for a single.
A lot of revs on that, on middle, jammed down the track.
Prince has played the spinners quite well till now. Rocks back and cuts the shortish ball through backward point for a brace.
Similar length ball, Masvaure is cramped for room as he punches it out.
The shorter length allows Prince to rock back and place it towards point.
Decides to use his feet but is not quite to the pitch of it. Ends up defending it towards the bowler.
Leans ahead and taps it with the spin to the leg side.
Shortish in length outside off, crunched away to sweeper cover to change strike.
That's a beauty! The wrong one from Shadab, lands around off as Masvaure fails to pick it up. Is beaten all ends up.
The length is an ideal one to get underneath it but Murray misreads the pace on it. Is hurried on by it and mistimes the pull towards long on. A single taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length, worked away against the spin towards short mid-wicket.
Low full toss on middle and leg, Prince plays his favourite shot, that is the sweep. Gets it away to deep square leg to change strike.
Spinning into Masvaure as he hangs back to dead-bat it.
Similar delivery, Murray is solid in his defense again. Another tidy over from Nawaz, only 3 from it.
On middle and off, Ryan lunges in defense.
Well played! Too straight this time, Murray chips it uppishly over mid-wicket. Has timed it quite well and he picks up a brace for doing so.
Coming in with the natural angle, defended with bat and pad close together.
Prince makes use of the depth of the crease to punch this one down the ground. A run taken.
Full and loopy ball outside off, tapped towards the cover region off the front foot.
Similar delivery, Murray once again is not to the pitch of the ball and is foxed once again.
Beaten! Spins away appreciably past the forward defense of Murray.
Quicker one around leg stump, Ryan tries to block but is struck on the pads.
Streaky! Tossed up ball on middle, Murray tries to drive it down the ground but gets it off the outer half of the bat through point. A brace results.
Straighter one from Shadab, Murray comes forward tentatively and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shadab has been off the radar so far. Once again bowls one down the leg side, the batsman sweeps it to fine leg to change strike.
Once again he makes use of his feet to turn it through mid on for a single.
Arm ball from Nawaz, Prince keeps it out nicely.
Hangs back and taps it towards mid-wicket who dives to stop it.

FOUR! Good intent from Masvaure! Need to keep it up as the asking rate is a tall one. Prince is nimble on his feet as he lifts this one over the bowler. There is no long off in place and he gets the desired result.
Spinning in, defended beside the pitch on the leg side.
Outside off, played with soft hands towards covers.
Quick and flat outside off, pushed to point.
Shadab slips in the googly, Murray doesn't pick it but manages to keep it out somehow.
Fuller in length around off, driven crisply to the man at mid off.
Masvaure works this one with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Starts off with a loosener, spinning down the leg side, swept away towards fine leg for a single.
Shadab Khan to roll his arm over now.
Slower through the air, a lot of loop and revolutions on that. Prince puts his head down and blocks it with authority.
Murray strides forward confidently to the tossed up ball and eases it down to long on for a run.
Close shave! The length is not that short to attempt a cut through point but Masvaure tries to do just that. Gets an inside edge that goes past the stumps towards fine leg. A single taken.
A touch straighter on this occasion, milked down past the short mid-wicket fielder to change strike.
Tight stump-to-stump line, Ryan leans ahead in defense.

That one almost sneaked through! Sliding in and stays a touch low. Murray shapes to chop it away but is in no sort of position. Gets beaten and the ball goes agonizingly past the off stump. Good take by Sarfraz behind the stumps.
Time for Drinks!
Full length ball, Prince puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Ali is working up a good rhythm. On a length, shaping in sharply. Murray gets it off the inner half around the corner. A run taken.
Pitched up ball, angling in, flicked nicely through mid-wicket. Three runs taken.
Fails to capitalize on the Free Hit! Low full toss on the pads, Murray is late to bring his bat down and inside edges it to the leg side. A run taken.
No ball! Fuller length ball again, worked away through square leg for a run. Ali overstepped on that occasion, a Free Hit coming up...

Ooh, almost! Ali goes wider of the crease from around the wicket and shapes in a fullish ball substantially. Prince tries to flick it away with the angle but completely bamboozled. The ball goes past his bat and also misses the off stump by a whisker.
Wide! Ali loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side, Masvaure tries to flick it but misses.
Full and straight, kept out down the track.
Tossed up ball, eased through mid on for a single.
Stump-to-stump line, Masvaure leans ahead and dead-bats it.
Similar ball, turned around the corner for a single.
An appeal for an LBW turned down! Quicker in pace, sliding in. Ryan tries to block it but is hit on the pads. Nawaz is confident but the umpire stays put. Perhaps sliding down leg.
Coming in with the natural angle, Murray lunges in defense.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, kept out watchfully. Another productive over for the visitors.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide! Very full ball, around leg stump, Prince tries to clip it away but misses. That was very close to the leg stump.
Back of a length outside off, guided to third man for a run and Murray gets off the mark.
Ryan Murray walks out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The sound of the timber is music to the ears of a fast bowler. A peach to get rid of the skipper. Ali steams in and bowls a length ball on middle and off. The ball pitches and straightens to square Masakadza up. He has no clue about it as he gets beaten and the middle stump goes for a toss. Ali celebrates in a typical Brett Lee like fashion. Kneeling and pumping his fist.
FOUR! In the air... but no one out in the deep! Short ball, climbing on Masakadza. He goes for the pull but gets a big top edge. No one out at fine leg and the ball races to the fence.
If there wasn't an inside edge, he was a candidate for an LBW. On a good length around off, angling in sharply. Masakadza is late to bring his bat down but the edge on his pads saves him.
Prince Masvaure comes out to bat.

OUT! Pakistan draw first blood! On a flatter trajectory, coming in with the arm. Kamunhukamwe gets into a position to force it through long on perhaps but is hurried a touch by the pace on the delivery. Ends up playing it towards short mid-wicket where Imam-ul-Haq dives to his left to take a good catch. A promising knock from the youngster is cut short.
Leans ahead to the tossed up ball and blocks it nicely.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Tries the arm ball again but ends up sliding it down the leg side, Kamunhukamwe kneels and sweeps it hard through fine leg to find the fence.
On a flatter trajectory on middle, kept out from the comfort of the crease.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, Tinashe tries to flick it but misses.
Fullish in length on middle, eased towards mid on for a single.
Wide! Quicker one but the line is awry as it is down the leg side. Hamilton tries to sweep it away but misses.
Shorter in length, cut nicely but straight to the man at extra cover.
Works it with the angle to the man at mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, the batsman guides it to point.
Fuller in length on middle, the batsman drives it back to the bowler.
SIX! The Zimbabweans are really playing well today! HM uses his feet and hits Hasan Ali over his head. It is right of the middle and it crosses the boundary with ease.
Fuller in length on off, the batsman drives it through covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, the batsman stands tall and guides it to point.
Tosses this up on middle, the ball is driven back to the bowler.
Times this through covers and a single results.
Shorter in length on off, HM punches it down to long off for a run. The fifty run stand is up. Could you beleive it? The two will now want to continue.
Fires it on the stumps, the batsman goes back and guides it through point for a run.
Shorter in length on middle, the batsman punches it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman strokes it to covers.
Mohammad Nawaz is into the attack.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
On off, it is punched through covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, the ball is pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter in length again outside off, the batsman guides it through point for a single.
Length again outside off, the batsman has a poke at it and misses.
On a length around off, Masakadza pushes it towards covers for a run.
Time for Powerplay 2! Four fielders will now be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Meanwhile, Hasan Ali is into the attack.
SIX! All the way! Ends Powerplay 1 in style! Full and on off, the batsman lofts it over mid off. The connection is such that the ball has cleared the ropes.
Shortish on off, the ball is punched to covers.
Hits the length hard on off, the batsman does well to keep it out.
On a length outside off, TK punches it through backward point and takes two.
On off, Masakadza walks across and flicks it to mid on for a run.
Back of a length on off, the batsman punches it to covers.
Down the leg side, the ball brushes the pads and goes towards the keeper who takes it and appeals. The umpire though shakes his head.
FOUR! Excellent timing! Slightly shorter in length outside off, TK off the back foot guides it through point and the ball races away.
Back of a length on off, the batsman tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length on off, the batsman guides it down to third man for a run.
Very full on off, Masakadza drives it to covers.
Another slower ball on off, Hamilton is foxed by it, he tries to defend but is beaten.
Slower ball on the pads, the batsman flicks it to the man at square leg.
FOUR! Lovely placement! Shortish and outside off, TK off the back foot punches it through point and the ball races away.
Back of a length on off, the ball is pushed to mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On the stumps, the batsman hits it back to the bowler.
Good length on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground. This is where Zimbabwe will have to improve. They are struggling to rotate strike which is very important.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller in length on off, HM strokes it to mid off.
SIX! Take that says Hamilton! What a shot! Slightly shorter on off, Masakadza shuffles across and helps it on its way over the square leg fence for a biggie.
On a length around off, Masakadza tries to drive but he gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
On a length again, HM pushes it back to the bowler.
Shortish on off, the batsman punches it to mid off.
Bowls it on a length around off, the batsman defends it solidly.
Back of a length on off, the ball is pushed to covers.
On the pads, Masakadza works it to mid-wicket. The fielder misfields and the batsmen cross over for a single.
On the pads, the batsman tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
FOUR! Save your head Junaid! Fuller in length on middle, Hamilton smashes it towards the bowler. He ducks for cover and the ball races to the fence. This is a good start by Zimbabwe.
On a length around off, TK guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Back of a length on off, Masakadza punches it to mid off. A maiden by Amir. Brilliant bowling.
Again! Lovely stuff from Amir. Continues attack the off stump and bowls it on a length. Masakadza pushes it to covers.
Length ball on middle, this one skids through after pitching. Masakadza somehow gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Shorter in length on middle, the batsman pushes it to mid on.
Lovely stuff! Lands this on a length and this angles it away. Masakadza tries to defend but is beaten.
Another lovely delivery outside off, the batsman makes a leave.
Shorter in length on off, it is pushed to cover-point.
SIX! Up in the air... and it goes all the way! Lovely strike. Short and on middle, Kamunhukamwe rocks back quickly and pulls it over the fine leg fielder for a biggie.
Back of a length on off, Kamunhukamwe is solid in defense.
Shorter in length on off, the batsman guides it to point.
Fuller in length on off, the batters drives it back to mid off.
BEATEN! Not sure he needs to be playing this. Length ball outside off, going across the batsman. He has a poke at it but getes beaten.
Hits the length hard again on off, HM keeps it out.
Slightly fuller outside off, Masakadza goes after, actually he played a nothing shot there. Gets beaten.
FOUR! First in this innings! That has gotten to the fence in no time! Full and on middle, Masakadza flicks it through mid-wicket and you do not need to run for those.
Back of a length on middle, HM pushes it back to the bowler.
Hits the length hard on off, Masakadza is solid in defense.
On a length around off, this one skids off the surface. Hamilton gets his bat down in time and he gets an inside edge.
Kamunhukamwe defends it from within the crease.
Another play and miss. Junaid is getting the ball to move. Forces Kamunhukamwe to cut it who once again cannot make any contact.
On middle and leg, Kamunhukamwe is solid in his defense.
Length again outside off, TK pokes at it but misses.
Good length ball, angles this away from the batsman who looks to leave it alone. He was late in doing so and it takes the bottom edge of the bat past the first slip fielder for a brace.
Length ball on middle and leg, Kamunhukamwe gets behind the ball and blocks it.
Junaid Khan will share the new ball.
Back of a length on off, Masakadza guides it to point.

Almost drags it on! Amir gets this one to swing back in a touch from outside off, Kamunhukamwe plants his front foot forward and tries to drive it through the off side but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a run.
First run for Zimbabwe! On the pads again on middle, Hamilton works it down to fine leg and gets to the other end.
Another ball in the corridor of uncertainty. HM shoulders his arms to it.
Good length on off stump, Masakadza defends it onto the ground.
Starts off with a ball down the leg side, no swing on offer. Masakadza tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.

We are back for the run chase. Out walk Hamilton Masakadza and Tinashe Kamunhukamwe. The former will be on strike and he will face Mohammad Amir who will start the proceedings for Pakistan. Here we go...
